hints.title: Associative Exclusive-Or Decomposition
hints.text: Every triplet exclusive-or outcome a ^ b ^ c can be decomposed into a pair result (a ^ b) combined with a third value c.

hints.title: Pairwise Reachability Set
hints.text: Compute all distinct pairwise exclusive-or results across the array.

hints.title: Triplet Consolidation
hints.text: Combine each unique pairwise exclusive-or with every element in the array to collect all distinct triplet results.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: P: number of unique pairwise XOR values
T: number of unique triplet XOR values
complexity.notes: Decomposing triplet generation into pairwise and third-element combinations reduces cubic complexity to quadratic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all triplets directly takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set containers eliminate duplicate values between stages.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply the associative property of XOR to group pair combinations.
